title: Identidad y memoria
goal: Read about Argentina's official 1984 "Nunca Más" report and Brazil's clandestine "Brasil: Nunca Mais" project, and how two very different processes arrived at the same formula.

items: Explain what challenge societies faced after dictatorships ended.
State what the CONADEP's 1984 report was called and who commissioned it.
Explain how "Brasil: Nunca Mais" was produced.
Describe what the two reports had in common despite different origins.
Use tanto... como to give equal weight to two elements.
I can explain what challenge societies faced after dictatorships ended.
I can state what the CONADEP's 1984 report was called and who commissioned it.
I can explain how "Brasil: Nunca Mais" was produced.

I can use tanto... como to give equal weight to two elements.
